body: MMR16 implementation decision after two independent read-only investigations: keep the proven native Scene.Read/VisualTestsScreen lifecycle. Boyle owns minimal WorldBridge ZGR6+PNG/LZ4/native-bundle encoder and independent Python decode comparisons; Harvey owns ready-scene query helper using exact installed API and review. Root owns runtime sequence, supervised worker integration and sole game/editor control. Fresh calibration(256m), FWGC42(800m), FWGC43(640m) generated after game launch, same indexed owned slot overwritten only after prior screen finalization and render-command retirement delay. Template contains local fixture material/environment definitions, not a world catalogue or distributable art. Gate query calls on 30 stable ReadyToRender+IsLoadingFinished+zero-shader frames. Record heights/normal/ground/native Scene+SceneView rays, camera projection/zoom, old-only region ray, bounds, screenshots and cleanup. Predeclared tolerances height .05m, ray .1m, normals1deg, projection2px; report mismatches explicitly rather than adapting tolerances silently. No old unready procedural-ray probes, no speculative ManualInvalidate. Current c1-c3 remain unproved; native allocation reclamation timing is not directly observable and will not be inferred merely from pointer/GC changes.
